issues.create.title: Create Issue
issues.create.description: Create a new issue in a Jira Cloud project.

projectKey.description: Key of the Jira project to create the issue in (e.g. "ENG").

summary.description: Short summary or title of the issue.

description.description: Optional plain-text description of the issue.

issueType.description: Issue type name, e.g. "Task", "Bug", "Story". Defaults to "Task".

assigneeId.description: Optional Atlassian account ID of the user to assign the issue to.

labels.description: Optional list of labels to attach to the issue.

issues.get.title: Get Issue
issues.get.description: Retrieve a single Jira issue by its key or ID from Jira Cloud REST API v3.

issueKey.description: The issue key (e.g. "PROJ-123") or numeric ID of the issue to retrieve.

issues.update.title: Update Issue
issues.update.description: Update fields on an existing Jira Cloud issue using the REST API v3 PUT /issue/{key} endpoint.

issueKey.description: The issue key (e.g. "PROJ-123") or numeric ID of the issue to update.

description.description: New plain-text description for the issue.

assigneeId.description: Atlassian account ID of the user to assign, or null to unassign.

labels.description: New set of labels for the issue (replaces existing labels).

updated.description: True if the update was accepted.

issues.delete.title: Delete Issue
issues.delete.description: Permanently delete a Jira Cloud issue by key or ID. This action is irreversible.

issueKey.description: The issue key (e.g. "PROJ-123") or numeric ID of the issue to delete.

deleteSubtasks.description: Whether to delete all subtasks of this issue. Defaults to false.

deleted.description: True if the issue was deleted.

issues.jql_search.title: Search Issues with JQL
issues.jql_search.description: Search Jira Cloud issues using a JQL (Jira Query Language) query via POST /rest/api/3/search.

jql.description: JQL query string, e.g. "project = PROJ AND status = 'In Progress' ORDER BY created DESC".

maxResults.description: Maximum number of issues to return. Defaults to 50.

startAt.description: Index of the first result to return (0-based). Defaults to 0.

fields.description: List of field keys to include in results. Defaults to all fields.

issues.comments.add.title: Add Comment to Issue
issues.comments.add.description: Add a new comment to an existing Jira Cloud issue via POST /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/comment.

issueKey.description: The issue key (e.g. "PROJ-123") or ID to add a comment to.

issues.comments.list.title: List Issue Comments
issues.comments.list.description: List all comments on a Jira Cloud issue via GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/comment.

issueKey.description: The issue key (e.g. "PROJ-123") or ID to list comments for.

startAt.description: Index of the first result to return (0-based). Defaults to 0.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of comments to return. Defaults to 50.

issues.transitions.list.title: List Issue Transitions
issues.transitions.list.description: List available workflow transitions for a Jira Cloud issue via GET /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/transitions.

issueKey.description: The issue key (e.g. "PROJ-123") or ID to list transitions for.

issues.transitions.do.title: Transition Issue
issues.transitions.do.description: Move a Jira Cloud issue to a new status by performing a workflow transition via POST /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/transitions.

issueKey.description: The issue key (e.g. "PROJ-123") or ID to transition.

transitionId.description: The ID of the transition to perform (get IDs from issues.transitions.list).

comment.description: Optional plain-text comment to add when performing the transition.

transitioned.description: True if the transition was performed.

issues.assign.title: Assign Issue
issues.assign.description: Assign a Jira Cloud issue to a user (or unassign it) via PUT /rest/api/3/issue/{key}/assignee.

issueKey.description: The issue key (e.g. "PROJ-123") or ID to assign.

accountId.description: Atlassian account ID of the user to assign the issue to. Pass null or omit to unassign.

assigned.description: True if the assignment was updated.

projects.get.title: Get Project
projects.get.description: Retrieve details of a single Jira Cloud project by its key or ID via GET /rest/api/3/project/{key}.

projectKey.description: The project key (e.g. "PROJ") or numeric ID of the project to retrieve.

users.get.title: Get User
users.get.description: Retrieve a single Jira Cloud user by Atlassian account ID via GET /rest/api/3/user.

accountId.description: The Atlassian account ID of the user to retrieve.

issues.changelog.get.title: Get Issue Changelog
issues.changelog.get.description: Retrieve the changelog for a Jira Cloud issue via GET /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/changelog.

issueKey.description: The issue key (e.g. "PROJ-123") or numeric ID.

startAt.description: Index of the first changelog item to return. Defaults to 0.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of changelog items to return. Defaults to 50.

issues.watchers.add.title: Add Issue Watcher
issues.watchers.add.description: Add a watcher to a Jira Cloud issue via POST /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/watchers.

issueKey.description: The issue key (e.g. "PROJ-123") or numeric ID.

accountId.description: Atlassian account ID of the user to add as a watcher.

added.description: True if the watcher was added.

issues.links.create.title: Create Issue Link
issues.links.create.description: Create a link between two Jira Cloud issues via POST /rest/api/3/issueLink.

inwardIssueKey.description: Issue key that is the inward side of the link (e.g. is blocked by).

outwardIssueKey.description: Issue key that is the outward side of the link (e.g. blocks).

comment.description: Optional plain-text comment to attach to the link.

worklogs.add.title: Add Worklog
worklogs.add.description: Add a worklog to a Jira Cloud issue via POST /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/worklog.

issueKey.description: The issue key (e.g. "PROJ-123") or numeric ID.

started.description: When the work started, in Jira datetime format.

myself.get.title: Get Current User
myself.get.description: Retrieve the currently authenticated Jira Cloud user via GET /rest/api/3/myself.

fields.list.title: List Fields
fields.list.description: List all system and custom fields in the Jira Cloud site via GET /rest/api/3/field.

webhook.jira.issue_created.title: Issue Created
webhook.jira.issue_created.description: Fires when a Jira issue is created.

webhook.jira.issue_updated.title: Issue Updated
webhook.jira.issue_updated.description: Fires when a Jira issue is updated.

webhook.comment_created.description: Fires when an issue comment is created.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Jira Cloud connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.

webhook.jira.issue_deleted.title: Issue Deleted
webhook.jira.issue_deleted.description: Fires when a Jira issue is deleted.

webhook.comment_updated.title: Comment Updated
webhook.comment_updated.description: Fires when an issue comment is updated.

webhook.comment_deleted.title: Comment Deleted
webhook.comment_deleted.description: Fires when an issue comment is deleted.

webhook.sprint_created.title: Sprint Created
webhook.sprint_created.description: Fires when a sprint is created.

webhook.sprint_updated.title: Sprint Updated
webhook.sprint_updated.description: Fires when a sprint is updated.

webhook.sprint_started.title: Sprint Started
webhook.sprint_started.description: Fires when a sprint is started.

webhook.sprint_closed.title: Sprint Closed
webhook.sprint_closed.description: Fires when a sprint is closed.

webhook.version_created.title: Version Created
webhook.version_created.description: Fires when a project version is created.

webhook.version_updated.title: Version Updated
webhook.version_updated.description: Fires when a project version is updated.

webhook.version_deleted.title: Version Deleted
webhook.version_deleted.description: Fires when a project version is deleted.

webhook.version_released.title: Version Released
webhook.version_released.description: Fires when a project version is released.

webhook.version_unreleased.title: Version Unreleased
webhook.version_unreleased.description: Fires when a project version is unreleased.

webhook.version_moved.title: Version Moved
webhook.version_moved.description: Fires when a project version is moved.

webhook.version_merged.title: Version Merged
webhook.version_merged.description: Fires when a project version is merged.

attachments.add.title: Add Attachment
attachments.add.description: Upload and attach a file to a Jira issue via POST /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/attachments.

issue_key.description: Issue ID or key to attach the file to.

file_to_upload.description: File payload with name and content or bytes.

projects.roles.actors.add.title: Add Users to Project Role
projects.roles.actors.add.description: Add users or groups to a project role via POST /rest/api/3/project/{projectIdOrKey}/role/{id}.

group_ids.description: Group IDs to add. Mutually exclusive with group_names.

group_names.description: Group names to add. Mutually exclusive with group_ids.

groups.users.add.title: Add User to Group
groups.users.add.description: Add a user to a Jira group via POST /rest/api/3/group/user.

account_id.description: Atlassian account ID of the user.

group_name.description: Group name. Provide group_name or group_id.

group_id.description: Group ID. Provide group_name or group_id.

expressions.analyse.title: Analyse Jira Expression
expressions.analyse.description: Analyse Jira expressions for syntax, type, or complexity via POST /rest/api/3/expression/analyse.

check.description: Check type: syntax, type, or complexity.

context_variables.description: Context variable types for the analyser.

issues.bulk_create.title: Bulk Create Issues
issues.bulk_create.description: Create up to 50 Jira issues in one call via POST /rest/api/3/issue/bulk.

issues.description: Issue definitions using the same fields as create issue.

permissions.check.title: Check User Permissions
permissions.check.description: Check global and project permissions via POST /rest/api/3/permissions/check.

account_id.description: Account ID to check. Defaults to the caller.

boards.create.title: Create Board
boards.create.description: Create a Jira Software board via POST /rest/agile/1.0/board.

type.description: Board type: kanban, scrum, or agility.

filterId.description: Filter ID that feeds the board.

groups.create.title: Create Group
groups.create.description: Create a Jira group via POST /rest/api/3/group.

jql.autocompletedata.create.title: Get JQL Autocomplete Data
jql.autocompletedata.create.description: Retrieve JQL autocomplete reference data via POST /rest/api/3/jql/autocompletedata.

project_ids.description: Project IDs used to filter visible fields.

include_collapsed_fields.description: Include collapsed fields with duplicate names.

projects.create.title: Create Project
projects.create.description: Create a Jira project via POST /rest/api/3/project.

lead_account_id.description: Atlassian account ID of the project lead.

sprints.create.title: Create Sprint
sprints.create.description: Create a sprint on a board via POST /rest/agile/1.0/sprint.

versions.create.title: Create Version
versions.create.description: Create a project version via POST /rest/api/3/version.

attachments.delete.title: Delete Attachment
attachments.delete.description: Delete an issue attachment via DELETE /rest/api/3/attachment/{id}.

issues.comments.delete.title: Delete Comment
issues.comments.delete.description: Delete an issue comment via DELETE /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/comment/{id}.

versions.delete.description: Delete a project version via DELETE /rest/api/3/version/{id}.

move_fix_issues_to.description: Version ID that should receive fix-version issues.

move_affected_issues_to.description: Version ID that should receive affected-version issues.

new_estimate.description: New remaining estimate when adjust_estimate is new.

increase_by.description: Amount to increase remaining estimate when adjust_estimate is manual.

override_editable_flag.description: Allow update when the issue is not editable.

expressions.evaluate.title: Evaluate Jira Expression
expressions.evaluate.description: Evaluate a Jira expression via POST /rest/api/3/expression/eval.

issues.bulk_fetch.title: Bulk Fetch Issues
issues.bulk_fetch.description: Fetch many issues by ID or key via POST /rest/api/3/issue/bulkfetch.

issueIdsOrKeys.description: Issue IDs or keys to fetch.

fieldsByKeys.description: Treat fields as keys rather than IDs.

query.description: Display name or email query string.

active.description: Restrict to active users when supported.

account_id.description: Filter to a single account ID.

users.search.query.title: Find Users 2
users.search.query.description: Deprecated user search via GET /rest/api/3/user/search (query, username, accountId).

users.picker.title: Find Users For Picker
users.picker.description: Find users for a picker via GET /rest/api/3/user/picker.

issuetypeschemes.list.title: Get All Issue Type Schemes
issuetypeschemes.list.description: List issue type schemes via GET /rest/api/3/issuetypescheme.

query.description: Filter by project name or key.

action.description: Permission used to filter visible projects.

statuses.list.title: Get Issue Statuses
statuses.list.description: List all issue statuses via GET /rest/api/3/status.

file_name.description: Suggested filename for the downloaded bytes.

issues.comments.get.description: Get one issue comment via GET /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/comment/{id}.

components.search.title: Get Component
components.search.description: List project components via GET /rest/api/3/project/{projectIdOrKey}/component, or get one component by ID.

query.description: Component name filter or component ID when no project is given.

projectIdsOrKeys.description: Project IDs or keys; the first value is used.

overrideSharePermissions.description: Include share permissions the caller cannot see.

group_name.description: Group name. Provide group_name or group_id.

servicedesk.info.description: Get Jira Service Management info via GET /rest/servicedeskapi/info.

override_editable_flag.description: Include fields even when the issue is not editable.

issuelinktypes.list.description: List issue link types via GET /rest/api/3/issueLinkType.

issues.picker.title: Get issue picker
issues.picker.description: Get issue picker suggestions via GET /rest/api/3/issue/picker.

issues.properties.get.title: Get Issue Property
issues.properties.get.description: Get an issue entity property via GET /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/properties/{propertyKey}.

started_before.description: Only worklogs started before this epoch ms.

jql.autocompletedata.get.title: Get JQL autocomplete reference data
jql.autocompletedata.get.description: Get JQL autocomplete data via GET /rest/api/3/jql/autocompletedata.

jql.autocompletedata.suggestions.title: Get JQL autocomplete suggestions
jql.autocompletedata.suggestions.description: Get JQL field suggestions via GET /rest/api/3/jql/autocompletedata/suggestions.

permissions.my.title: Get My Permissions
permissions.my.description: Get the caller's permissions via GET /rest/api/3/mypermissions.

myself.locale.get.title: Get User Locale Preference
myself.locale.get.description: Get the caller's locale via GET /rest/api/3/mypreferences/locale.

permissions.projects.title: Get Permitted Projects
permissions.projects.description: List projects the caller can access with given permissions via POST /rest/api/3/permissions/project.

projects.types.get.title: Get Project Type
projects.types.get.description: Get a project type via GET /rest/api/3/project/type/{projectTypeKey}, or list types when the key is omitted.

project_type_key.description: Project type key: business, software, or service_desk.

projects.recent.title: Get Recent Projects
projects.recent.description: List recently viewed projects via GET /rest/api/3/project/recent.

issues.remotelinks.list.title: Get Issue Remote Links
issues.remotelinks.list.description: List remote issue links via GET /rest/api/3/issue/{issueIdOrKey}/remotelink.

serverinfo.get.title: Get Server Info
serverinfo.get.description: Get Jira Cloud site info via GET /rest/api/3/serverInfo.

servicedesk.requesttype.fields.title: Get Service Desk Request Type Fields
servicedesk.requesttype.fields.description: Get request type fields via GET /rest/servicedeskapi/servicedesk/{serviceDeskId}/requesttype/{requestTypeId}/field.

avatars.owner.title: Get Universal Avatar Type Owner
avatars.owner.description: List avatars for an owner via GET /rest/api/3/universal_avatar/type/{type}/owner/{entityId}.

avatars.view.type.description: Get the default avatar view via GET /rest/api/3/universal_avatar/view/type/{type}.

users.groups.list.description: List a user's groups via GET /rest/api/3/user/groups.

avatars.view.get.description: Get an avatar image via GET /rest/api/3/universal_avatar/view/type/{type}/avatar/{id}.

issues.description: Issue keys or IDs to move.

groups.users.remove.description: Remove a user from a group via DELETE /rest/api/3/group/user.

projects.roles.actors.remove.description: Remove a user or group from a project role via DELETE /rest/api/3/project/{projectIdOrKey}/role/{id}.

account_id.description: Account ID to remove from watchers.

jql.description: Bounded JQL. Required unless next_page_token is a full token.

next_page_token.description: Pagination token from a previous search.

issues.search.action.description: Search issues with structured filters or raw JQL via POST /rest/api/3/search/jql.

jql.description: Raw JQL. Takes precedence over structured filters.

assignee.description: Account ID, email, display name, or unassigned.

created_after.description: Created after YYYY-MM-DD or relative date.

updated_after.description: Updated after YYYY-MM-DD or relative date.
